# Pull Request Template

## 📌 Description

Please include a clear and concise description of your changes.

* What does this PR do?
* Why is this change needed?
* What problem does it solve?

---

## 🔗 Related Issues

Link any related issues here (if applicable):

* Closes #
* Fixes #
* Related to #

---

## 🧪 Type of Change

Please mark the relevant option(s):

* [ ] 🐛 Bug fix
* [ ] ✨ New feature
* [ ] 💥 Breaking change
* [ ] 📝 Documentation update
* [ ] ♻️ Refactor
* [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
* [ ] ✅ Test update
* [ ] 🔧 Chore / Maintenance

---

## 🚀 How Has This Been Tested?

Describe the tests you ran and how to reproduce them:

* [ ] Unit tests
* [ ] Integration tests
* [ ] Manual testing

Provide details:

```
Steps to test:
1.
2.
3.
```

---

## 📸 Screenshots (if applicable)

Add screenshots or screen recordings to help explain your changes.

---

## ✅ Checklist

Before submitting your PR, please confirm:

* [ ] My code follows the project’s style guidelines
* [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
* [ ] I have commented my code where necessary
* [ ] I have added/updated tests where applicable
* [ ] All tests pass locally
* [ ] Documentation has been updated (if needed)
* [ ] No sensitive data (API keys, secrets) is included

---

## ⚠️ Breaking Changes

If this PR introduces breaking changes, describe them here:

```
Describe impact and migration steps
```

---

## 💬 Additional Notes

Add any other context or information about this PR here.

(Optional) Highlight specific areas where you’d like feedback.
